title: Park Guell
text: We went during the European heat wave sooo it was very hot. Minimal shade or seating areas to rest in main tour areas. Water & snacks must be brought with you- none available inside(stands outside gates for purchase). Very interesting- we had the best guide with Crown Tours- Bernard. He explained the symbolism and history really well. Tour was perfect length ~55 minutes. It was nice to see. Esp if you are a Gauti fan. Numerous nearby cafes dining options if desired. Must walk a few blocks into town area for taxi/city bus. Great gift shop!
author: Sandra_T
